source_audit.automdl: Only emitted when ammaxlag() is nonempty, lines500–510; Stella omits ammaxlag, ammaxdiff, and ammodel.
source_audit.outliers: Stella specifies outauto(all), outmethod(addone), translated as types=(all), method=addone. The archived reconstruction uses outlier{} with defaults.
source_audit.forecast: sax12 defaults ammaxlead=12, ammaxback=0, probability=.95; estimate{} always emitted.

caveat: Current Census X-13 executable is retained; the original X-12 vintage and special handling of missing original tid549 are unavailable.

direct_software_validation.method: Executed unmodified sax12.ado in Stata MP batch with the deposited options and justspc on a synthetic quarterly series; no Census executable was invoked.
direct_software_validation.result: Generated specification confirms every estimation option in the sax12 variant; no arima, automdl, regression, or pickmdl block.
direct_software_validation.note: Validation fixture uses entirely synthetic revenues; the absolute data path in generated SPC is replaced only when executing its fixture in tests.
